logger.doc:name: Log Request
logger.message: POST /cases - Processing COVID case submission for: #[payload.firstName] #[payload.lastName]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { source: payload.source, caseType: payload.caseType, firstName: payload.firstName, lastName: payload.lastName, phone: payload.phone, email: payload.email, dateOfBirth: payload.dateOfBirth, nationalID: payload.nationalID, nationalIDType: payload.nationalIDType, streetAddress: payload.address.streetAddress, city: payload.address.city, state: payload.address.state, postal: payload.address.postal, country: payload.address.country, createDate: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, updateDate: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"} }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert COVID Case
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO CVD_CASE_MASTER ( SOURCE, CASE_TYPE, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, DATE_OF_BIRTH, NATIONAL_ID, NATIONAL_ID_TYPE, STREET_ADDRESS, CITY, STATE, POSTAL, COUNTRY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( :source, :caseType, :firstName, :lastName, :phone, :email, TO_DATE(:dateOfBirth, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), :nationalID, :nationalIDType, :streetAddress, :city, :state, :postal, :country, TO_DATE(:createDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), TO_DATE(:updateDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )

db:select.doc:name: Get Generated Case ID
db:select.db:sql: SELECT CASE_SEQ.CURRVAL as CASE_ID FROM DUAL

logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.message: COVID case created successfully with ID: #[payload.caseID]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "Database Connection Error", message: "Unable to connect to database. Please try again later.", timestamp: now(), correlationId: correlationId }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "Database Query Error", message: "Error executing database operation. Please check your data and try again.", timestamp: now(), correlationId: correlationId }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "Internal Server Error", message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.", timestamp: now(), correlationId: correlationId }
